name: New Moon at Its Zenith

{Rouse} {Tempting Honeyfruit} is enhanced.
After using {Crimson Furnace}, the next {Miracle Blessing} Discovers 1 additional {derived:Caraboo's Blessing} card per set. After playing a {derived:Caraboo's Blessing} card, {Embryo Fusion} +10. This fusion effect increases based on your lost HP, up to +100%.
